species_support: human collagen-VI adhesion assays and mammalian chondrocyte/vascular smooth-muscle models
evidence_summary: Primary adhesion, affinity and cell-blocking studies identify alpha1beta1 and alpha2beta1 as receptors for native type-VI collagen substrates and collagen-VI microfibrillar assemblies, with beta1-dependent cell-adhesion outputs.
limitations: Retain assembled native collagen-VI and integrin-adhesion context; the candidate names an individual COL6A5/COL6A6 chain not resolved in these native type-VI studies, so do not promote it as a chain-specific direct edge or infer a soluble signaling cascade.
